[quote=sal-baliz;58768483][b]The Village - Part 2[/b]
On the evening of March 11th, a small group of Sal-Baliz soldiers were sent to Al-Qasr. News had come to the Islamic council that the residents of this small village did not follow pure Islam. After around 30 minutes of looking around the village, the soldiers split up and began breaking into peoples houses. They cold-heartedly stabbed innocent civilians to death in an attempt to please Allah. The residents began to rally against them, so they called in back up. A team of 20 Sal-Baliz soldiers, armed with AK-47s arrived at the scene. Bullets soon began to fly in all directions. Nobody could escape the wrath of the Sal-Baliz, no matter how hard they tried. The sound of gunfire echoed through the desolate expanse. Soon, all that was left of the residents was piles of dead bodies, overflowing with blood. The soldiers immediately got to work cleaning up their mess, by burning the evidence. The sky was lit up orange as house after house was set alight. This incident remains a horrible reminder to the people inside the Sal-Balizs controlled territory that they will not tolerate dissent.[/quote]

After a long day of reviewing satellite images of West Shamat, Pvt Clive Addams comes across an image of a burning village with a GPS location to the south of Majeera, the ULR's most northern holding since 1883 and the fall of the Wituli empire. His commanding officer comes over, and looks over his shoulder as he sips on a cup of coffee.

Officer: "What's that?"

Clive: "Some attacked village. Not much of importance, but we might need to increase border security for Majeera." [i]Rubbing his eyes, Clive yawns and saves the photo for reference if needed later.[/i]

Officer: "Come on man, you need to get home. You have a date tomorrow after all."

Clive: "Yah... I'll see you Sunday."
